2608.02578.title: CoWAM: Coordination Contracts for Selective Policy Intervention with WAMs
2608.02578.paper_summary: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot policies with action-conditioned predicted futures, but a plausible future alone does not justify changing the action that a bimanual policy would execute. We present CoWAM, a selective intervention layer that expresses synchronization, role compatibility, and collision convergence as coordination contracts. Each contract combines typed admissibility checks with event-conditioned verification and calibrated intervention gates. CoWAM preserves the nominal action unless an alternative satisfies every active obligation and provides a clear, low-risk improvement; when the nominal action is also inadmissible, it invokes a predefined abstention fallback. To separate selector quality from proposal quality, all methods operate on identical candidate pools and commit their decisions before shared oracle labeling. Across eight simulated bimanual tasks, CoWAM improves coordination-valid selection by 16.7 percentage points over the contract-only variant and raises closed-loop success by 9.6 percentage points over the strongest selective baseline, while keeping harmful interventions below 1%. Together, these results establish coordination contracts as an effective interface for conservative policy intervention with predicted world-action evidence across coordination-rich bimanual tasks.
2608.02578.paper_summary_zh: 世界行動模型（WAMs）通過動作條件的預測未來來增強機器人政策，但僅僅一個合理的未來並不足以證明改變雙手政策所執行的動作是合理的。我們提出了CoWAM，一個選擇性介入層，將同步、角色兼容性和碰撞收斂表達為協調合約。每個合約將類型可接受性檢查與事件條件驗證和校準的介入閘結合在一起。CoWAM保留名義行動，除非替代方案滿足每一個主動義務並提供明確的低風險改進；當名義行動也是不可接受的時候，它會調用預定的放棄回退。為了將選擇器質量與提案質量分開，所有方法在相同的候選池上運作，並在共享神諭標記之前承諾其決策。在八個模擬的雙手任務中，CoWAM將協調有效選擇提高了16.7個百分點，相較於僅有合約的變體，並將閉環成功率提高了9.6個百分點，相較於最強的選擇性基準，同時將有害介入保持在1%以下。總體而言，這些結果確立了協調合約作為保守政策介入的有效介面，並提供了預測世界行動證據，適用於協調豐富的雙手任務。
